stats.label: PTE Academic tests taken globally, 2022 — up 90% on 2021

institute.analysis: That growth reflects a widening set of tests now accepted by institutions and immigration authorities, not a single default exam — effective preparation increasingly means current, format-specific expertise across several tests rather than depth in one.

stats.label: international students in the US, 2024/25 — up 5% on the year before
international students in Australia, year to May 2026 — down 6.9%

education.analysis: International student mobility now tracks visa and post-study-work policy as closely as underlying demand — the same period that saw US enrolment grow 5% saw Australia's contract, inside a market HolonIQ projects will more than double, from $196B to $433B, by 2030. A market that moves like that rewards counseling built around more than one destination country.

workforce.analysis: Real movement on one half of the problem, a persistent gap on the other: nationally, the employment rate for people with a disability is 22.8%, against 8.3% unemployment — roughly double the unemployment rate for people without one. Closing the distance between services received and jobs held is the specific gap workforce development exists to close.
